_doc: Production-funnel templates (Thesis Tree, PREREG_thesis_tree.md section 3). Written before any test. Stages: S0 primary inputs, S1 tools & capital equipment, S2 components & intermediates, S3 assembly / OEM / processors, S4 sellers, distribution & logistics, S5 end demand (macro: no listed members). A sub-industry may sit in several chains. Sub-industries not listed belong to the service layer (outside the funnel). Firm-level overrides come later, from the 10-K business description, frozen per year with the reason recorded.

ai_semis.about: AI and semiconductors: power, gases and chemicals -> fab tools and data-centre build -> chips and components -> systems and networking -> cloud platforms that sell compute -> enterprise and consumer demand
S5: macro: enterprise IT spending, consumer electronics demand

autos.about: Autos and EV: metals and chemicals -> machinery -> parts and chips -> vehicle makers -> dealers -> consumers
S5: macro: retail auto sales, consumer credit

aerospace_defense.about: Aerospace and defence: metals -> machinery -> aero parts (firm overrides) -> airframers and primes -> airlines and governments
S5: macro: defence budgets, air travel demand

energy.about: Oil and gas: producers -> oilfield services -> midstream -> refiners -> fuel buyers

power.about: Power: fuels -> generation equipment -> generators -> utilities -> households, industry and data centres

homebuilding_construction.about: Construction: materials and timber -> heavy machinery -> building products -> builders and engineers -> distributors and home-improvement retail -> households (rates)
S5: macro: housing starts, mortgage rates, non-residential construction

consumer_staples.about: Staples: crops and fertiliser -> farm machinery -> packaging -> branded producers -> grocers and distributors -> households
S5: macro: real consumer spending, retail sales (food)

apparel_discretionary.about: Discretionary goods: materials -> brands and makers -> retailers, distributors and freight -> consumers

healthcare.about: Health care: research tools -> supplies -> drug and device makers -> distributors, providers and services -> payers and patients

cloud_software.about: Software: data-centre infrastructure -> platforms and systems software -> applications -> integrators -> enterprise IT budgets

media_telecom.about: Media and telecom: network equipment and towers -> carriers and content makers -> ad platforms and agencies -> consumers and advertisers

travel_leisure.about: Travel: aircraft -> airlines, hotels, cruise and gaming operators -> consumers
S5: macro: travel demand, real consumer spending

service_layer.about: Outside the funnel: financial intermediation, real estate and business services. Their links enter through exposures (rates, credit, consumer spending, S4/S5 activity), not through stage propagation.

unlisted_rule: A sub-industry that appears in the S&P 500 or S&P 400 data but in none of the lists above is assigned in the commit that completes the pre-registration, before any test runs, by the same reading of GICS definitions, and the assignment is logged. Nothing is assigned after a result is seen.
